title: feat(app-shell): the /data filter bar offers single-value relation fields, so Members View all filters by User
body:
Fixes #13310
Clause-②: no

## What

`ObjectDataPage` (the `/data` surface "View all" opens; it anchors no declared view, objectui#12741) derives its filter bar from the object definition. It derived picklist-like fields only. It now also offers **single-value relation fields** (`lookup`, `master_detail`, `user`), so an organization's Members "View all" page can be filtered by User (ruling F1 on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24815).

- The derivation is one exported helper, `deriveDataPageUserFilterFields`: picklist fields first in declaration order (exactly the old set and order), then single-value relation fields in declaration order, under the unchanged `MAX_USER_FILTERS` cap of 4. Hidden fields, unreadable fields and `multiple: true` relations are never offered.
- Nothing else changes. A relation chip is rendered by `UserFilters`' existing `LookupValuePicker` branch (search by name; the query goes through the caller's data source); a pick emits `[field, 'in', [id]]`, the id predicate `ListView` already ANDs into the list query; the selection rides the existing `uf_FIELD` URL param. `UserFilters.tsx`, `userFilterUrlState.ts` and `LookupValuePicker` are untouched.

**Ruling 2 (cap and order).** Measured: `sys_member` declares `organization_id`, `user_id` and `role`, three fields, so the cap does not cost the Members page its User filter and the cap stays 4. Relations are ordered AFTER picklists so that an object whose picklists already fill the cap keeps exactly the bar it had; that order is pinned. On Members the bar reads Role, Organization, User.

**Pin (b), which of the two.** The field IS offered, matching what `LookupValuePicker` already does: it scopes by asking the caller's data source, not by hiding the chip. An unreadable related object answers with a refusal and the picker lists no options (it shows the refusal text).

## Tests

New `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectDataPage.relationUserFilters-13310.test.tsx`: the real `ObjectDataPage`, with `ListView` replaced by a stand-in that hands `schema.userFilters`, the restored `uf_*` selections and the selection callback to the REAL `UserFilters` and real `LookupValuePicker`.

- (a) Members: the bar is Role, Organization, User; picking a member emits `user_id in [id]` and keeps 1 row, a non-member keeps 0. A `user`-typed field filters by id the same way.
- (b) the picker queries `demo_vault` through the data source; the refusal leaves no options.
- (c) CONTROL: a picklist-only object renders Status, Priority, Urgent and no lookup chip.
- (d) a `multiple: true` user field, a `multiple: true` lookup, a hidden lookup and an unreadable lookup are not offered.
- (e) the pick writes `uf_user_id`; a reload with that URL restores the condition and the resolved label; a stale `uf_user_id=u_gone` shows `u_gone`, no error.
- order and cap: picklists keep all four slots when they fill the cap; relations follow them in declaration order.

Run on the tree committed as `76f01dd1a2` (the final commit), under the shared verify lock: the new file plus the families naming the touched file (`ObjectDataPage.*` five files, `userFilterUrlState.listState-11860`), 7 files, 85 tests passed. `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`, which lists the new test) exit 0 after a turbo build of the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure. The full `packages/app-shell/` directory is declared to CI, not run locally.

**Ablation** (through `ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 to 0): `USER_FILTER_RELATION_TYPES` emptied. Predicted: (a), (e) and the ordering case RED; (c) GREEN. Observed: 6 failed, 3 passed. Red: both (a) cases, (b), (d), (e), the relation-order case. Green: (c), the picklists-keep-their-slots case, the no-fields case. (b) and (d) also went red, which the prediction did not say: both assert the single-value relation chips are present (the field offered in b; `assignee`/`vault` remaining in d), so they need the relation set too. Restore proved by blob hash: `d8f37661c3fe` after restore equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Browser measurement (Done when)

A real stack: objectstack `origin/main` `28c9a2cb66` `examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` on a private port), with this branch's console (`apps/console` vite, proxied to it), driven by Playwright Chromium, signed in as the seeded admin. Data: the Default Organization; Ada Auditor (demo) removed from it through better-auth `organization/remove-member`, so she is a user who is not a member.

- Organization record, Members tab, **View All** opens `/apps/setup/sys_member/data?filter[organization_id]=org_mvhxp7nxzorku6gl` with 2 records. Bar: Role, Organization, User.
- **User**, search "Dev", pick Dev Admin (a member): **1 record**; URL gains `uf_user_id=AVv0T5ffUcGSwUccNvxX3YUU3zN5ysf0`.
- Clear, search "Ada", pick Ada Auditor (demo) (not a member): **0 records** ("No matching records"); URL `uf_user_id=usr_showcase_auditor_demo`.
- Reload: still 0 records, the User chip still shows 1 selection.

## Gates (exit codes, final commit `76f01dd1a2`)

All 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`.

`eslint --no-inline-config` narrowed to the two changed source files: exit 0, 0 errors, 14 warnings, the same count the `origin/main` copy of `ObjectDataPage.tsx` produces (one new `only-export-components` for the exported helper, one `no-explicit-any` removed). The narrowing is a measurement: both files sit under the config's `**/*.{ts,tsx}` block; the file count is 2 from `--format json`; the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- System relation fields count as relations: on an ordinary object the injected `created_by`, `updated_by` and `owner_id` lookups now become eligible after the declared fields, inside the same cap. `sys_member` carries none.
- `docs/adr/0055-parameterized-bare-data-surface.md` point 4 still says the bar derives from enum-ish fields. An ADR is a dated record, so it is not edited here; carrier: none.
- One `.changeset/13310-data-page-relation-filters.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.
- No objectstack metadata change; no free-text page search; no multi-value relations.
